title: Realistic Sun & Moon
description: By default, Minecraft’s sky travels directly overhead along a fixed axis. This mod adds a 45-degree tilt. This makes the sky look more interesting and more realistic than the straight line 90 degree paths.
body:
## Overview
By default, Minecraft’s sky moves overhead along a straight line. This mod changes that by adding 45-degree tilt.

### Features
Realistic Sun Moon & Stars: The Sun Moon and Stars will now rise and set at an angle, instead of going overhead at the exact point above you.

Client-Side Only: No server-side mods required.

## Compatibility
Fabric Loader

26.1.2

Dependencies

Fabric API

## Installation
Install the Fabric Loader and Fabric API.

Download the most recent build of this mod from the files page.

Place the .jar file into the mods folder and launch Minecraft.
